text:
sara_sales: FYI ACME POC stuck on onboarding — SCIM user create returns 403 for several users. Okta app says provisioned but users missing in Redwood. Need help ASAP.

nate_se: Can you paste the SCIM request/response logs? Also, do we have their IdP metadata and the SCIM token they configured? Common culprits: missing email attribute or NameID mismatch.

lee_idp_eng: 403 usually means Okta is sending a malformed payload or our SCIM app isn't seeing the required attributes. Confirm Okta SCIM mappings: make sure `email` is mapped to `user.profile.email` and attribute permissions are granted on the app.

olivia_ops: Dedicated pool is ready for their POC but they can't call inference — their VPC allowlist doesn't include the API key's CIDR yet. Sara, can you confirm which deployment (hosted/dedicated/private) they selected?

sara_sales: They're trying Dedicated + SSO. Also getting SAML failures: Audience mismatch + invalid certificate thumbprint in our logs. Posting snippet of SAML response (redacted):

```xml
<saml:Assertion>
  <saml:Issuer>https://dev-123.okta.com/app/abcd1234</saml:Issuer>
  <saml:Subject>
    <saml:NameID Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress">alice@acme.co</saml:NameID>
  </saml:Subject>
  <saml:Conditions>
    <saml:AudienceRestriction>
      <saml:Audience>https://redwood.example.com/saml/consume</saml:Audience>
    </saml:AudienceRestriction>
  </saml:Conditions>
</saml:Assertion>
```

lee_idp_eng: Ok — two things: 1) Ensure the SP EntityID/Audience in Okta matches our SP URL (we often see the trailing slash or `/consume` mismatch). 2) NameID format should be `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress` (looks ok here). For the certificate issue, check that they uploaded the current IdP cert to our console or SP cert in Okta. If Okta rotated certs recently you'll see signature validation fail.

nate_se: Also double-check SCIM token — if they rotated it on their side we return 401/403 intermittently. If needed we can accept a short-lived token for the POC and rotate later.

olivia_ops: Workaround: we can manually invite the initial set of users into the Dedicated tenant and grant them POC roles while we sort SCIM. That gets them unblocked for demos. We can also create a scoped API key bound to the dedicated pool (expires in 7 days) for their engineers.

carol_ciso: Quick security note for the questionnaire: confirm SCIM uses TLS, tokens are stored in KMS-backed secrets, and provisioning events go to audit logs retained for 90 days. I'll need the exact wording to add to the doc.

onboarding_bot: Created support ticket #5678 for this issue and added Nate and Lee.

sara_sales: I'll pull full SCIM logs and their IdP metadata and schedule a call for tomorrow 10am PST. Sending the Okta admin screenshot now.

nate_se: Thanks — once we have the IdP metadata + SCIM logs I'll run a repro against our staging SCIM endpoint and post findings here.

lee_idp_eng: If we can't reproduce, suggest a quick screenshare with their Okta admin. 20–30min should be enough.

sara_sales: Got it. Scheduling call and sharing artifacts. :thumbsup:

olivia_ops: I'll standby to flip the allowlist and issue the short-lived API key if needed. :ok_hand:

carol_ciso: Approved the temporary scoped key for the POC, ensure it's logged. :white_check_mark:
